scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run start -w @little/mobile
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run web -w @little/mobile
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run dev -w @little/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @little/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run export:web -w @little/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @little/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:api
